title: Jane Kim
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Jane Kim (Democratic Party) is running for election for California Commissioner of Insurance. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
Kim was a member of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors in California, representing District 6. She left office in 2019.
Kim completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
